title: AI × Bio 每日精选
subtitle: 计算生物学、组学、蛋白质与生物医学模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: MOSAIC: Learning Graph Node Embeddings from Spectrally Isolated Dominant Subspaces of Accumulated Diffusion Operators
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical knowledge graphs can connect information across genes, phenotypes, tissues, pathways, experiments, and clinical resources, but they are difficult to query correctly without detailed knowledge of the graph. Large language models can help write Cypher code for knowledge graphs, yet a query focused on a bioinformatics task that looks reasonable may still use the wrong identifier, relationship direction, source, intermediate node, or output unit if the user is not completely trained on the schema We developed ddkg.skill, an Agent Skill that can be loaded into a compatible LLM session to support querying of the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem Data Distillery Knowledge Graph (DDKG), a biomedical property graph integrating more than 180 ontologies, over 40 genomics datasets, and dozens of additional cross-domain biomedical datasets. Rather than utilizing a simple markdown prompt, ddkg.skill contains a controller, a compositional library of DDKG-specific references and structured tables, primary documentation, validated query patterns, a routing table, and a Python script that checks the internal links among these materials. The skill build for the December 2025 DDKG release contains 38 bundled files and 239 routing relationships and is identified by checksum so users can state the exact build used to compose a query. The evaluation reported here was performed separately on an earlier build with 38 files and 227 routing entries. In that orthogonal nine-test evaluation against a live December 2025 DDKG instance, five of seven tests targeting sources absent from the worked examples produced correct executed results. The evaluation also exposed a failed query, a cross-source comparison that was not biologically well posed, and errors in the skill's own reference material that informed later revisions. The skill guides an AI through entity resolution, graph inspection, query construction, and validation for biomedical and bioinformatics queries, while keeping the DDKG itself as the source of returned results. This design provides a portable and versioned method for giving general-purpose AI systems practical knowledge of a complex biomedical knowledge graph to empower complex bioinformatics data integration. Three executed biomedical use cases further demonstrate cross-species phenotype-to-expression querying, genomic overlap between 4DN chromatin-loop anchors and GTEx eQTLs, and integration of congenital heart phenotype associations with ClinVar and GTEx heart evidence.
items.summary_zh: 提出可版本化的 ddkg.skill，帮助大语言模型可靠查询整合 NIH DDKG 生物医学知识图谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把实体解析、图谱检查、查询构造和验证流程结构化，并以可复现实验揭示技能包的有效性与局限。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学知识图谱可以连接基因、表型、组织、通路、实验和临床资源中的信息，但如果不熟悉图谱的详细模式，就很难正确查询。大语言模型可以帮助编写知识图谱的 Cypher 代码，但如果用户没有接受完整培训，一个看似合理、聚焦生物信息学任务的查询仍可能使用错误的标识符、关系方向、来源、中间节点或输出单位。我们开发了 ddkg.skill，这是一种可加载到兼容 LLM 会话中的 Agent Skill，用于支持对 NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem Data Distillery Knowledge Graph（DDKG）的查询。DDKG 是一个生物医学属性图谱，整合了 180 多个本体、40 多个基因组数据集以及数十个其他跨领域生物医学数据集。ddkg.skill 不采用简单的 markdown 提示，而是包含控制器、DDKG 专用参考资料和结构化表格、主要文档、经过验证的查询模式、路由表，以及用于检查这些材料内部链接的 Python 脚本。2025 年 12 月 DDKG 发布版的 skill 构建包含 38 个捆绑文件和 239 条路由关系，并通过校验和标识，因此用户可以声明用于组合查询的确切构建版本。本研究报告的评估在更早的构建版本上单独完成，该版本包含 38 个文件和 227 条路由关系。在一个实时的 2025 年 12 月 DDKG 实例上进行的正交九项测试中，针对示例中未出现来源的七项测试有五项产生了正确的执行结果。评估还暴露出一次失败查询、一个生物学上定义不恰当的跨来源比较，以及 skill 自身参考材料中的错误，这些发现推动了后续修订。该 skill 引导 AI 完成实体解析、图谱检查、查询构造和验证，同时将 DDKG 本身保留为结果来源。这种设计为通用 AI 系统提供了一种可移植、可版本化的方法，使其获得复杂生物医学知识图谱的实用知识，从而支持复杂的生物信息学数据整合。三个已执行的生物医学用例进一步展示了跨物种表型到表达的查询、4DN 染色质环锚点与 GTEx eQTL 的基因组重叠，以及先天性心脏表型关联与 ClinVar 和 GTEx 心脏证据的整合。
items.author_line: Mohseni Ahooyi T, Stear B, Zhang Y, Lahiri A, Terry J, Zhang S, Simmons JA, Corbett R, Sullivan P, Chinwalla A, Nemarich C, Rokita JL, Diskin S, Silverstein JC, Taylor DM

items.title: Cohort-scale Spatial Host-Microbiome Predicts Post-Resection Recurrence in Colorectal Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: The tumor microenvironment in colorectal cancer (CRC) is a heterogeneous ecosystem in which host cells and microbial communities interact dynamically, influencing disease progression. However, the clinical utility is limited by the lack of a scalable spatial host-microbiome technique and by insufficient integration of artificial intelligence for the interpretation of high-dimensional multi-omics data. To overcome the barriers, we present AlphaFISH, a platform technology integrating both technical and computational innovations for multi-omics spatial analysis of clinical biopsies at subcellular resolution. The system uses a sequencing-free, high-throughput, spatial profiling technique to construct, to date, the largest clinical spatial transcriptomics and spatial microbiome datasets acquired from 149 colorectal biopsies from 68 human subjects, supported by a comprehensive scRNA-seq atlas covering 4.27 million cells across 650 patients for robust cell annotation. Deep learning of the cohort-scale dual-omics data, consisting of more than 10 million subcellular sampling vectors, enables the development of a transformer model with joint embeddings of gene expression, spatial architecture, and the microbial microenvironment in colon tissues, achieving nearly 90% accuracy in predicting CRC-associated pathological features using unseen spatial omics inputs. The AI interrogation further predicts tumour recurrence at 81% accuracy in 28 patients followed within 1 year post tumor resection period. AlphaFISH reveals that spatial interactions between Fusobacterium and cellular niche consisting of tumor and T cells serve as key markers of CRC malignancy, progression, and recurrence, indicating the critical role of spatial bacterial-immune crosstalks.
items.summary_zh: AlphaFISH 将亚细胞空间宿主—微生物组学与深度学习结合，用于结直肠癌病理特征和术后复发预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究整合149例活检、4.27百万细胞图谱和超过1000万空间采样向量，展示了大规模临床空间多组学的转化潜力。
items.abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）的肿瘤微环境是一个异质性生态系统，其中宿主细胞与微生物群落动态相互作用，影响疾病进展。然而，由于缺乏可扩展的空间宿主—微生物组技术，以及对高维多组学数据的人工智能解释整合不足，其临床实用性受到限制。为克服这些障碍，我们提出 AlphaFISH，这是一种整合技术和计算创新、用于在亚细胞分辨率下分析临床活检多组学空间信息的平台技术。该系统采用无需测序的高通量空间分析技术，构建了截至目前规模最大的临床空间转录组和空间微生物组数据集，数据来自 68 名受试者的 149 份结直肠活检样本；同时以覆盖 650 名患者、包含 4.27 million 个细胞的综合 scRNA-seq 图谱支持稳健的细胞注释。对队列规模双组学数据进行深度学习，这些数据包含超过 10 million 个亚细胞采样向量，构建了一个联合嵌入基因表达、空间结构和结肠组织微生物微环境的 transformer 模型。该模型在未见过的空间组学输入上预测 CRC 相关病理特征的准确率接近 90%。AI 分析进一步在肿瘤切除术后 1 年内随访的 28 名患者中，以 81% 的准确率预测肿瘤复发。AlphaFISH 显示，Fusobacterium 与由肿瘤细胞和 T 细胞组成的细胞生态位之间的空间相互作用，是 CRC 恶性程度、进展和复发的重要标志，提示空间细菌—免疫串扰具有关键作用。
items.author_line: Guo, F., Sun, H., Hu, C., Hao, M., Wan, Y., Xiong, C., Gao, F., Mak, L.-Y., Deng, X., Goel, A., Ke, J., Ma, J., Shi, P.

items.title: Advancing Ultrasound Beamforming With Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Review of Methods, Datasets, Benchmarks, and Computational Challenges.
items.abstract_or_text: Ultrasound imaging is a widely used diagnostic tool, and beamforming techniques are integral to its performance. Traditional methods such as delay-and-sum (DAS) and delay-multiply-and sum (DMAS) have limitations in terms of image quality and computational efficiency. Recently, deep learning approaches have shown significant promise in improving ultrasound beamforming, offering enhanced image resolution and quality, alongside potential for real-time processing. This review is aimed at providing a comprehensive overview of the current state-of-the-art in deep learning-based ultrasound beamforming. It focuses on analyzing various deep learning models, their applications, challenges, and the integration of hardware optimization strategies to enhance performance and efficiency. The review examines a range of deep learning models applied to ultrasound beamforming, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), transformer-based models, and hybrid approaches. It also discusses the challenges associated with dataset limitations, model interpretability, and the risk of overfitting. Furthermore, the review explores hardware acceleration using field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), along with cloud-edge frameworks for real-time inference. The findings highlight the potential of deep learning models to outperform traditional methods in terms of image quality and resolution. However, challenges such as the need for large and diverse datasets, the black box nature of deep learning models, and the risk of overfitting remain. Hardware optimization through FPGAs has proven effective in enabling real-time processing, but the integration of edge computing with cloud-based solutions offers promising avenues for balancing performance, latency, and energy efficiency. Deep learning-based ultrasound beamforming has great potential to advance medical imaging. Future efforts should enhance model generalizability with diverse and synthetic data, optimize hardware for real-time use, and establish standardized validation protocols to support clinical adoption.
items.summary_zh: 综述深度学习超声波束形成的模型、数据集、基准、硬件加速和临床转化挑战。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统比较 CNN、GAN、transformer 和混合方法，并强调数据多样性、可解释性、过拟合及标准化验证仍是临床采用的瓶颈。
items.abstract_zh: 超声成像是一种广泛使用的诊断工具，波束形成技术对其性能至关重要。延迟求和（DAS）和延迟相乘求和（DMAS）等传统方法在图像质量和计算效率方面存在局限。近年来，深度学习方法在改进超声波束形成方面显示出很大潜力，可提高图像分辨率和质量，并有望实现实时处理。本综述旨在全面概述基于深度学习的超声波束形成的当前技术水平，重点分析各种深度学习模型、其应用、挑战，以及硬件优化策略的整合，以提升性能和效率。综述考察了应用于超声波束形成的多类深度学习模型，包括卷积神经网络（CNN）、生成对抗网络（GAN）、基于 transformer 的模型和混合方法。文章还讨论了数据集有限、模型可解释性和过拟合风险等挑战。此外，综述探讨了使用现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）进行硬件加速，以及用于实时推理的云—边缘框架。研究结果强调，深度学习模型在图像质量和分辨率方面可能优于传统方法。然而，大规模且多样化数据集的需求、深度学习的黑箱特性和过拟合风险仍然存在。通过 FPGA 进行硬件优化已被证明能够有效实现实时处理，而将边缘计算与基于云的解决方案结合起来，则为平衡性能、延迟和能效提供了有前景的路径。基于深度学习的超声波束形成具有推进医学成像的巨大潜力。未来工作应利用多样化和合成数据提升模型的泛化能力，针对实时使用优化硬件，并建立标准化验证方案以支持临床采用。
items.author_line: Hadri H, Fail A, Sadik M

items.title: Construction of a Prognostic Model for Pancreatic Cancer Based on mitochondrial dynamics-Related Genes: Application of Multiple Machine Learning Methods
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Purpose To investigate the prognostic significance of mitochondrial dynamics-related genes in pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) and determine whether a machine learning-derived signature could predict patient survival, tumor microenvironment characteristics, and therapeutic response. Methods Transcriptomic and clinical data from TCGA-PAAD and normal pancreatic tissues from GTEx were analyzed to identify differentially expressed mitochondrial dynamics-related genes. Multiple machine learning algorithms were applied to construct a prognostic model, which was externally validated using ICGC and GEO cohorts. Survival, Cox regression, functional enrichment, somatic mutation, immune infiltration, and drug sensitivity analyses were performed. Single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics were used to characterize the cellular and spatial distributions of the core genes. Results Thirty-two prognostic mitochondrial dynamics-related genes were identified, of which seven genes—ALDH3A1, CD36, CKB, FOXM1, IGF2BP3, INS, and MET—were selected for the final signature. The resulting risk score effectively stratified patients into groups with significantly different survival outcomes and remained an independent prognostic factor after adjustment for clinicopathological variables. High-risk tumors were associated with cancer progression, cell-cycle and motility pathways, immunosuppressive features, distinct somatic mutations, and reduced sensitivity to several chemotherapeutic agents. Single-cell analysis localized multiple signature genes predominantly to ductal epithelial cells, while spatial analysis showed increasing MET expression during malignant progression. Conclusion The seven-gene mitochondrial dynamics signature provides a potential tool for prognostic stratification and therapeutic-response prediction in PAAD. Prospective clinical validation and functional experiments are required before clinical application.
items.summary_zh: 基于 TCGA、GTEx、ICGC、GEO 及单细胞和空间转录组数据构建胰腺癌线粒体动力学七基因预后特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 外部队列验证和多组学定位提高了模型可信度，但作者明确指出仍需前瞻性临床验证和功能实验。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：研究线粒体动力学相关基因在胰腺腺癌（PAAD）中的预后意义，并确定机器学习衍生的特征是否能够预测患者生存、肿瘤微环境特征和治疗反应。方法：分析 TCGA-PAAD 的转录组和临床数据，以及 GTEx 的正常胰腺组织数据，以识别差异表达的线粒体动力学相关基因。应用多种机器学习算法构建预后模型，并使用 ICGC 和 GEO 队列进行外部验证。开展生存分析、Cox 回归、功能富集、体细胞突变、免疫浸润和药物敏感性分析。利用单细胞 RNA 测序和空间转录组学刻画核心基因的细胞和空间分布。结果：鉴定出 32 个具有预后意义的线粒体动力学相关基因，其中 ALDH3A1、CD36、CKB、FOXM1、IGF2BP3、INS 和 MET 七个基因被选入最终特征。所得风险评分有效地将患者分为生存结局显著不同的组；在校正临床病理变量后，风险评分仍是独立预后因素。高风险肿瘤与癌症进展、细胞周期和细胞运动通路、免疫抑制特征、不同的体细胞突变以及对若干化疗药物敏感性降低相关。单细胞分析显示，多个特征基因主要定位于导管上皮细胞；空间分析显示，MET 表达随恶性进展而增加。结论：这七基因线粒体动力学特征为 PAAD 的预后分层和治疗反应预测提供了潜在工具。在临床应用前仍需开展前瞻性临床验证和功能实验。
items.author_line: Gongping M, Yuchuan L, Shu Q

items.title: Explainable machine learning estimates clinically significant prostate cancer risk in men with PSA 4–20 ng/mL
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Men with prostate-specific antigen (PSA) values of 4–20 ng/mL often have overlapping risks of benign disease, clinically insignificant prostate cancer, and clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). We retrospectively studied 859 men who underwent pathological evaluation; 76 had csPCa. Twelve prediction algorithms were assessed with 500 bootstrap resamples. In every resample, LASSO feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and model fitting used only the bootstrap training sample, and performance was estimated from patient-level out-of-bag predictions. C5.0 had the highest AUROC point estimate (0.843, 95% CI 0.801–0.886), an AUPRC of 0.421, and a Brier score of 0.066. Calibration was broadly concordant at low-to-moderate predicted risks but uncertain in the sparse high-risk tail. At a 0.10 risk threshold, the model would avoid 544.8 biopsies per 1,000 men while missing 10.5 csPCa cases per 1,000. PSA-derived measures supplied most of the linear predictive signal, whereas the clearest additional gain arose with nonlinear integration. C5.0 may support pre-biopsy triage, but multicenter external validation, recalibration assessment, and prospective impact studies are required before clinical use.
items.summary_zh: 在 PSA 4–20 ng/mL 的859名男性中比较12种算法，评估可解释模型对临床显著性前列腺癌风险的估计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 采用 bootstrap 训练内特征选择和患者级 out-of-bag 评估，量化了活检减少与漏诊之间的权衡，并明确需要多中心前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）值为 4–20 ng/mL 的男性，常同时存在良性疾病、临床无意义前列腺癌和临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）的重叠风险。我们回顾性研究了 859 名接受病理学评估的男性，其中 76 人患有 csPCa。使用 500 次 bootstrap 重采样评估 12 种预测算法。在每次重采样中，LASSO 特征选择、超参数调优和模型拟合仅使用 bootstrap 训练样本完成，性能则由患者级 out-of-bag 预测估计。C5.0 的 AUROC 点估计最高，为 0.843（95% CI 0.801–0.886）；AUPRC 为 0.421，Brier 分数为 0.066。在低到中等预测风险范围内，校准总体一致，但高风险尾部因样本稀疏而不确定。在 0.10 风险阈值下，该模型每 1,000 名男性可避免 544.8 次活检，同时漏掉 10.5 例 csPCa。PSA 衍生指标提供了大部分线性预测信号，而最明显的额外增益来自非线性整合。C5.0 可能支持活检前分诊，但在临床使用前仍需多中心外部验证、重新校准评估和前瞻性影响研究。
items.author_line: Xie S, Wang Q, Wang X, Jiang X, Gao H, Luo Y, Fan L, Li Q, Wang H, Cai X, Zhou W, Wu T

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for Chronic Care Pathway Optimization: A Unified Framework across Three Clinical Goal Types
items.abstract_or_text: Chronic care requires sequential treatment under competing biomarker, safety, and cost constraints, yet clinical goal structures differ across diseases. This version asks whether one physiology-informed reinforcement-learning paradigm can be written once and then instantiated for three goal structures (treat-to-target, multi-marker cruise, and bounded cycle completion) without a disease-specific policy architecture. Gout, chronic kidney disease, and PCOS-mediated fertility treatment are the three instances. Training is behaviour cloning followed by proximal policy optimization on 500 simulated trajectories per disease. Evaluation uses paired seeds (N = 50 primary; N = 500 bootstrap 95% confidence intervals), multi-seed offsets 42-51, ablation, and out-of-distribution profiles. PCOS (cycle completion): PPO 72.0% against the doctor baseline 54.0% at N = 50; at N = 500, PPO 69.8% [65.6, 73.8] against doctor 52.8% [48.8, 57.2]. Gout (treat-to-target): PPO 88.0% against 90.0% (McNemar p = 1.0). CKD (cruise): doctor 32.0%, BC/PPO 38.0%. This v2 withdraws three bibliographic coordinates that appeared in v1 and that do not match any recoverable source. The withdrawn comparison is replaced by a NOR-Gout calibration at weeks 4, 8 and 12 that belongs to the recalibrated kernel of the parallel journal manuscript. Shared BC-to-PPO training is instantiated across the three goal types without cross-disease weight sharing. Prospective validation remains necessary.
items.summary_zh: 在痛风、慢性肾病和 PCOS 生育治疗三个目标结构中测试统一的生理学信息强化学习框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 报告了行为克隆加 PPO 的模拟比较、消融和分布外评估，但结果来自模拟轨迹，尚不能替代前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 慢性病管理需要在生物标志物、安全性和成本约束相互竞争的情况下进行序贯治疗，但不同疾病的临床目标结构并不相同。本版本考察一个生理学信息强化学习范式是否可以只编写一次，然后在三种目标结构（目标治疗、多标志物维持和有界周期完成）中实例化，而无需针对疾病设计不同的策略架构。三个实例分别是痛风、慢性肾病和 PCOS 介导的生育治疗。训练过程为行为克隆，随后在每种疾病的 500 条模拟轨迹上进行近端策略优化。评估采用配对随机种子（主要 N = 50；bootstrap 95% 置信区间 N = 500）、多随机种子偏移 42–51、消融和分布外特征。PCOS（周期完成）：N = 50 时 PPO 相对医生基线为 72.0% 对 54.0%；N = 500 时 PPO 为 69.8% [65.6, 73.8]，医生为 52.8% [48.8, 57.2]。痛风（目标治疗）：PPO 为 88.0%，医生为 90.0%（McNemar p = 1.0）。慢性肾病（维持）：医生为 32.0%，BC/PPO 为 38.0%。本 v2 版本撤回了 v1 中出现、且与任何可恢复来源均不匹配的三个文献坐标。撤回的比较由第 4、8 和 12 周的 NOR-Gout 校准替代，该校准属于并行期刊稿件重新校准后的内核。三种目标结构均采用共享的 BC-to-PPO 训练流程，但不同疾病之间不共享权重。仍需开展前瞻性验证。
items.author_line: Wang, R., Chen, H., Wu, Y., Li, Z., Shen, R., He, F., Zhao, S., Zheng, N.

items.title: Explainable machine learning identifies predictors for postural instability and cognitive impairment in early Parkinsons Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Parkinsons disease (PD) exhibits considerable variability in symptom onset, severity, and clinical trajectories, making prediction of individual disease progression a complex challenge. Leveraging large multimodal datasets from two independent cohorts of early PD patients, we examined predictive features for progression to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and postural instability (PI) using Explainable Boosting Machines (EBM) - an interpretable machine learning (ML) approach. We found comparable predictive performances of EBM models using a minimal clinico-demographic dataset compared to an extended multimodal dataset including volumetric brain imaging and fluid biomarkers. Baseline age and Montreal Cognitive Assessment total score were identified as most important predictive features for both MCI and PI using the minimal dataset, while additional motor, cognitive and imaging features were identified using the extended dataset. Our study highlights the potential of ML predictions of cognitive and motor endpoints of PD progression at the individual level bringing personalized clinical decision-making within reach.
items.summary_zh: 在两个独立早期 Parkinsons disease 队列中，用可解释 boosting 模型识别轻度认知障碍和姿势不稳的进展预测因子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示简化的临床人口学数据与扩展多模态数据表现相近，为评估个体化预测的增量价值提供了依据。
items.abstract_zh: Parkinsons disease（PD）在症状出现、严重程度和临床轨迹方面存在显著差异，因此预测个体疾病进展是一项复杂挑战。我们利用两个独立的早期 PD 患者大型多模态数据集，采用可解释 boosting machine（EBM）这一可解释机器学习方法，研究进展为轻度认知障碍（MCI）和姿势不稳（PI）的预测特征。我们发现，与包含脑容量成像和体液生物标志物的扩展多模态数据集相比，仅使用最小临床—人口学数据集的 EBM 模型也取得了相近的预测性能。在最小数据集中，基线年龄和 Montreal Cognitive Assessment 总分被确定为预测 MCI 和 PI 最重要的特征；在扩展数据集中，还识别出其他运动、认知和成像特征。本研究强调，机器学习有望在个体层面预测 PD 的认知和运动终点，使个体化临床决策更接近实际应用。
items.author_line: Sailer, B., Roeben, B., Kiefer, C., Achauer, L.-C., Kemmner, R., Wurster, I., Lerche, S., Bender, B., Lindig, T., Schulte, C., Deuschle, C., Erhardt, C., Gasser, T., Brockmann, K., Kohlbacher, O., Biergans, S., Liepelt-Scarfone, I.

items.title: Extraction of clinical information from faxed medical records using a small local large language model pipeline on consumer hardware
items.abstract_or_text: Objective Specialty referral packets often arrive by fax and clinicians must manually read and organize a large amount of disparate information to affect continuity of care. Commercial large language models (LLMs) can organize packet information, but protected health information (PHI) must be secured. We evaluated whether an open-weight pipeline running entirely on one consumer graphics card can accurately extract clinical information from faxed referral packets. Materials and Methods We generated 200 synthetic colorectal cancer referral packets from simulated patient records, rendered them as faxes without a text layer. A local pipeline transcribed each packet with an optical character recognition model (OvisOCR2) and extracted structured data with an open-weight LLM (Qwen3.8 27B). Twenty outcomes spanning patient identifiers, laboratory results, dates, diagnoses, procedures, medications, imaging, and event chronology were scored against ground truth on 140 validation packets. Results Laboratory values were extracted exactly in 98.9% of 7879 instances, dates in 99.7%, diagnoses in 100%, and procedures in 92.9%. Timeline recall was 96.7% and precision 99.4%. Weighted accuracy was 0.990 (95% CI 0.987 - 0.992). None of 11,993 extracted facts were fabricated. Median processing time was 90 seconds per packet. Conclusion An open-weight pipeline on consumer hardware accurately extracted multi-domain clinical information from synthetic faxed referrals.
items.summary_zh: 在单张消费级 GPU 上运行 OCR 与 Qwen3.8 27B 的本地管线，从无文本层传真转诊包中提取结构化临床信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在合成数据上实现高准确率且未发现事实幻觉，说明本地部署可作为隐私敏感场景的可复现基线，但尚需真实临床资料验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：专科转诊资料包经常通过传真到达，临床医生必须手动阅读并整理大量分散信息，以维持医疗连续性。商业大语言模型可以组织资料包信息，但必须保护受保护健康信息（PHI）。我们评估了一个完全在一张消费级显卡上运行的开放权重管线，能否准确提取传真转诊资料包中的临床信息。材料与方法：我们根据模拟患者记录生成了 200 份合成结直肠癌转诊资料包，并将其渲染为没有文本层的传真。一个本地管线先用 OCR 模型 OvisOCR2 转录每份资料包，再用开放权重 LLM Qwen3.8 27B 提取结构化数据。我们在 140 份验证资料包上，以真实值为标准，对涉及患者标识符、实验室结果、日期、诊断、操作、药物、影像和事件时间线的 20 项结局进行评分。结果：在 7879 个实例中，实验室数值的精确提取率为 98.9%，日期为 99.7%，诊断为 100%，操作为 92.9%。时间线召回率为 96.7%，精确率为 99.4%。加权准确率为 0.990（95% CI 0.987–0.992）。提取的 11,993 条事实中没有一条被捏造。每份资料包的处理时间中位数为 90 秒。结论：在合成传真转诊资料上，运行于消费级硬件的开放权重管线能够准确提取多领域临床信息。

items.title: Longitudinal linear-epitope profiling of SLE identifies novel antigens associated with disease and disease activity
items.abstract_or_text: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is the prototypical systemic autoimmune disease defined by the production of autoantibodies directed against diverse self-antigens. Antinuclear antibodies (ANA) are central to SLE diagnosis, and anti-double-stranded DNA (anti-dsDNA) antibodies are clinically used to track disease activity. However, these biomarkers provide only partial insight into the full spectrum of autoimmune changes in patients. To expand the known landscape of SLE autoreactivity shared among patients and associated with disease activity, we performed an unbiased characterization of 1,268 SLE plasma samples from 695 SLE patients and 301 healthy controls using phage immunoprecipitation and sequencing (PhIP-seq). This technique preferentially displays linear epitopes, and thus provides a complementary set of autoreactivities to previously discovered autoreactive targets. Despite the marked clinical heterogeneity of SLE, machine learning applied to this data surfaced a shared, reproducible signature that robustly discriminates between SLE and healthy controls in two validation cohorts. Autoreactivities in SLE were significantly enriched for RNA-binding protein targets. Autoreactive proteins containing Basic Acidic Dipeptides (BAD) repeat domains, features associated with biomolecular condensate formation, distinguished patients with high disease activity (by SLEDAI score) from patients with no disease activity. Among all shared autoreactivities, a peptide derived from YTHDF2 emerged as the most prevalent target across SLE cohorts occurring in ~25% of SLE patients and displayed striking sequence similarity to a peptide derived from the Epstein Barr virus (EBV) lytic switch protein BZLF1. Competition assays demonstrated higher-affinity binding to the viral peptide, supporting a model in which antiviral humoral responses to EBV may drive secondary epitope spreading toward molecularly mimicked self-antigens. Remarkably, orthogonal validation using the Luminex bead platform containing a panel of only 10 peptides, including BZLF1, demonstrated strong discrimination between SLE and healthy controls (AUC = 0.95). Together, these findings identify a rich, greatly expanded landscape of autoreactivities in SLE, candidate biomarkers associated with high disease activity, and provide mechanistic insight linking EBV-driven immunity to epitope-specific autoimmunity in lupus.
items.summary_zh: 利用 PhIP-seq 分析1268份 SLE 血浆样本，发现可重复的自身反应性特征及与疾病活动相关的候选抗原。
items.why_it_matters_zh: YTHDF2/BZLF1 分子模拟线索和10肽 Luminex 验证将大规模筛选连接到可检验的自身免疫机制假说。
items.abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是典型的系统性自身免疫病，其特征是产生针对多种自身抗原的自身抗体。抗核抗体（ANA）是 SLE 诊断的核心，抗双链 DNA（anti-dsDNA）抗体则用于临床追踪疾病活动度。然而，这些生物标志物只能部分反映患者自身免疫变化的完整谱系。为扩展已知的、在患者之间共享并与疾病活动度相关的 SLE 自身反应性图谱，我们使用噬菌体免疫沉淀与测序（PhIP-seq），对来自 695 名 SLE 患者的 1,268 份血浆样本和 301 名健康对照进行了无偏表征。该技术优先展示线性表位，因此能够为此前发现的自身反应性靶标提供互补信息。尽管疾病具有显著的临床异质性，对这些数据应用机器学习后，得到一个共享且可重复的特征，在两个验证队列中均能稳健地区分 SLE 与健康对照。SLE 的自身反应性显著富集于 RNA-binding protein 靶标。含有 Basic Acidic Dipeptides（BAD）重复结构域的自身反应性蛋白具有与生物分子凝聚体形成相关的特征，能够区分 SLEDAI 评分所定义的高疾病活动度患者与无疾病活动度患者。在所有共享的自身反应性中，源自 YTHDF2 的肽成为各 SLE 队列中最常见的靶标，约出现在 25% 的 SLE 患者中；该肽与 Epstein Barr virus（EBV）裂解开关蛋白 BZLF1 的一段肽表现出显著的序列相似性。竞争实验显示，抗体对病毒肽的结合亲和力更高，这支持一种模型：针对 EBV 的抗病毒体液免疫反应可能通过分子模拟，驱动继发性表位扩展至自身抗原。值得注意的是，使用仅含 10 条肽（包括 BZLF1）的 Luminex 微球平台进行正交验证，能够强力区分 SLE 与健康对照（AUC = 0.95）。综上，这些发现确定了 SLE 中大幅扩展的自身反应性图谱、与高疾病活动度相关的候选生物标志物，并提供了将 EBV 驱动的免疫反应与狼疮中表位特异性自身免疫联系起来的机制线索。

items.title: Three Cerebellar Imaging Subtypes in Schizophrenia with Distinct Spatiotemporal Trajectories and Biological Characteristics
items.abstract_or_text: The potential role of the cerebellum in the pathophysiology of schizophrenia (SCZ) has received relatively insufficient attention. Prior studies characterized cerebellar abnormalities mainly at the group level, without fully considering the heterogeneity of the disease. Here, we applied a machine learning approach (Subtype and Stage Inference, SuStaIn) to cross-sectional 3D volumetric MRIs of the cerebellum, including 1,588 individuals with SCZ (638 females; mean age: 31.9 +/- 12.0 years) and 2,341 healthy controls (HC) (1,041 females; mean age: 33.3 +/- 13.6 years), from 17 sites worldwide. SuStaIn identified three distinct spatiotemporal trajectories in cerebellar gray matter volume (GMV) reduction, respectively originating in lobule X (subtype 1), lobule III (subtype 2) and lobule VIIb (subtype 3), with subtypes 1 and 3 corresponding to the posterior lobe and subtype 2 to the anterior lobe. These cross-sectionally inferred trajectories were replicated in two independent samples of 1,334 and 530 patients, respectively. Multimodal analyses using neuroimaging, transcriptomic and behavioral data revealed subtype-specific biological characteristics in brain morphological patterns, cerebellar-cortical connectivity, gene expression and clinical symptoms. Specifically, subtype-related genes were enriched in metabolism-related processes and immunity-related processes, respectively, in subtype 1 and subtype 2; subtype 3 showed more severe brain abnormalities and worse cognitive symptoms. Treatment data from 381 patients, with up to 12 months of follow-up, revealed poorer response to antipsychotic medications (APM) in subtype 2 and subtype 3, but better response to transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) in subtype 1, which also had worse emotion-related symptoms. Together, our findings offer a comprehensive characterization of the heterogeneity of cerebellar pathophysiological progresses in SCZ, which may help in developing future clinical stratification and targeted intervention strategies.
items.summary_zh: 基于17个站点的3D 小脑 MRI，SuStaIn 识别出三种精神分裂症小脑灰质体积时空轨迹，并在独立样本中复现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将影像、转录组、行为和治疗随访关联到亚型，提示分层研究方向，但横断面轨迹仍不等同于个体纵向因果进程。
items.abstract_zh: 小脑在精神分裂症（SCZ）病理生理学中的潜在作用此前受到的关注相对不足。既往研究主要在群体层面描述小脑异常，没有充分考虑疾病的异质性。在本研究中，我们将机器学习方法 Subtype and Stage Inference（SuStaIn）应用于小脑横断面 3D 体积 MRI，样本包括来自全球 17 个站点的 1,588 名 SCZ 个体（638 名女性；平均年龄 31.9 +/- 12.0 岁）和 2,341 名健康对照（HC）（1,041 名女性；平均年龄 33.3 +/- 13.6 岁）。SuStaIn 识别出三种不同的小脑灰质体积（GMV）减少时空轨迹，分别起始于 X 小叶（亚型 1）、III 小叶（亚型 2）和 VIIb 小叶（亚型 3）；亚型 1 和 3 对应后叶，亚型 2 对应前叶。这些基于横断面推断的轨迹在两个独立样本中得到复现，样本量分别为 1,334 和 530 名患者。利用神经影像、转录组和行为数据进行的多模态分析揭示了亚型特异性的脑形态模式、小脑—皮层连接、基因表达和临床症状生物学特征。具体而言，亚型相关基因分别在代谢相关过程和免疫相关过程中富集于亚型 1 和亚型 2；亚型 3 表现出更严重的脑异常和更差的认知症状。来自 381 名患者、最长 12 个月随访的治疗数据显示，亚型 2 和亚型 3 对抗精神病药物（APM）的反应较差，而亚型 1 对经颅磁刺激（TMS）的反应较好；亚型 1 同时具有更严重的情绪相关症状。总体而言，本研究全面刻画了 SCZ 小脑病理生理进程的异质性，可能有助于未来制定临床分层和靶向干预策略。

items.title: Patterns of GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Initiation Compared With Other Glucose-Lowering and Anti-Obesity Therapies Among Older Adults
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have rapidly expanded from primarily glucose-lowering agents for type 2 diabetes (T2D) to therapies used across diabetes, obesity, and cardiometabolic disease. Prescribing has risen sharply since 2018, especially with the broader uptake of semaglutide-based products. Still, real-world initiation patterns remain incompletely characterized in older adults with varying levels of cognitive vulnerability and frailty. Methods: We analyzed treatment patterns of GLP-1RA use in a retrospective cohort of adults aged >=65 years with T2D in a regional healthcare system from 2018 to 2026. We describe the demographic and clinical characteristics of new initiators of GLP-1RAs compared with initiators of alternative therapies, including sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP-4i). We analyzed a sub-cohort of patients to identify the prevalence of baseline cognitive concerns using a large language model (LLM). We used a LASSO logistic regression to identify important predictors of GLP-1RA initiation compared to other therapies. Results: Of 58,754 adults aged 65 years or older with T2D, 5,095 initiated GLP-1RA, 5,483 initiated a SGLT2 inhibitor, and 1,516 initiated a DPP-4 inhibitor. GLP-1RA initiators were younger (mean 75.2 [SD 4.9] vs 77.7 [6.0] and 79.5 [7.1] years) and less often aged 80 years or older (17.7% vs 35.0% and 47.6%). The largest difference across groups was adiposity: mean BMI was 33.8 (6.2) vs 29.7 (5.7) and 28.6 (5.6) kg/m2 (SMD 0.592), with a BMI of 30 kg/m2 or higher in 72.1% vs 41.9% and 34.0%. Glycemic control was similar (mean HbA1c 7.46% vs 7.38% and 7.70%; SMD 0.165). GLP-1RA initiators were younger; more likely to be overweight; had lower average comorbidity index; and less dementia, heart failure, and renal disease than those initiating alternative therapies. GLP-1RA initiators had fewer hospitalizations 1-year prior to drug initiation. In a LASSO model, BMI greater than 27 kg/m2 was the strongest predictor of GLP-1RA initiation (positive), followed by baseline congestive heart failure (negative) and baseline hospitalization (negative). Conclusion: In this cohort of older adults, those with T2D who initiated GLP-1RAs were younger and had less comorbidities at baseline compared to initiators of other T2D therapies. Overweight BMI was the strongest predictor of GLP-1RAs initiation, whereas baseline HbA1c was similar across groups, suggesting that the decision to start GLP1-RA is more influenced by adiposity than glycemic control. Our analysis of real-world prescribing patterns appear to be in alignment with guidelines for Type II diabetes treatment1, which recommend GLP-1RA treatment for glucose lowering and weight management and SGLT2 treatment in those with risk of cardiovascular disease or heart failure.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性分析58754名老年 T2D 患者的 GLP-1RA 启动模式，发现 BMI 而非 HbA1c 是最强预测因素。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大样本真实世界比较揭示了老年患者中 GLP-1RA 与替代药物启动者的基线差异，但不能据此推断治疗效果或因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：胰高血糖素样肽-1 受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）已从主要用于降低血糖的 2 型糖尿病（T2D）药物，迅速扩展为用于糖尿病、肥胖和心脏代谢疾病的治疗。自 2018 年以来，处方量快速上升，尤其是在基于 semaglutide 的产品更广泛采用之后。然而，对于认知脆弱性和衰弱程度不同的老年人，真实世界的启动模式仍未得到充分刻画。方法：我们分析了一个区域医疗系统中年龄 >=65 岁、患有 T2D 的成年人在 2018 至 2026 年间使用 GLP-1RA 的治疗模式。我们描述 GLP-1RA 新启动者与其他替代治疗新启动者的​​人口学和临床特征，替代治疗包括钠—葡萄糖协同转运蛋白-2 抑制剂（SGLT2i）和二肽基肽酶-4 抑制剂（DPP-4i）。我们分析一个亚队列，使用大语言模型（LLM）识别基线认知问题的患病率。我们使用 LASSO logistic 回归，识别相对于其他治疗而言 GLP-1RA 启动的重要预测因子。结果：在 58,754 名年龄 65 岁或以上的成年人中，5,095 人启动 GLP-1RA，5,483 人启动 SGLT2 抑制剂，1,516 人启动 DPP-4 抑制剂。GLP-1RA 启动者更年轻（平均 75.2 [SD 4.9] 岁，对比 77.7 [6.0] 岁和 79.5 [7.1] 岁），年龄达到 80 岁或以上的比例也更低（17.7%，对比 35.0% 和 47.6%）。各组间最大的差异是肥胖程度：平均 BMI 为 33.8 (6.2)，对比 29.7 (5.7) 和 28.6 (5.6) kg/m2；BMI 为 30 kg/m2 或以上的比例为 72.1%，对比 41.9% 和 34.0%。血糖控制相近（平均 HbA1c 为 7.46%，对比 7.38% 和 7.70%；SMD 0.165）。GLP-1RA 启动者更年轻、更可能超重，平均合并症指数更低，痴呆、心力衰竭和肾脏疾病更少。GLP-1RA 启动者在用药启动前 1 年内的住院次数更少。在 LASSO 模型中，BMI 大于 27 kg/m2 是 GLP-1RA 启动最强的正向预测因子，其次是基线充血性心力衰竭和基线住院，两者均为负向预测因子。结论：在该老年人队列中，与启动其他 T2D 治疗者相比，启动 GLP-1RA 的患者更年轻，基线合并症更少。超重 BMI 是 GLP-1RA 启动的最强预测因素，而基线 HbA1c 相近，提示启动 GLP-1RA 的决策更多受肥胖程度影响，而非血糖控制。我们的真实世界处方模式分析似乎与 II 型糖尿病治疗指南一致：指南建议 GLP-1RA 用于降低血糖和体重管理，并建议心血管疾病或心力衰竭风险患者使用 SGLT2 治疗。
items.author_line: Brooks, J. D., Donahue, M. A., ElHassan, A., Tian, J., Hernandez-Diaz, S., Blacker, D., Estiri, H., Haas, J. S., Moura, L. M. V. R.

items.title: Pervasive Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Genomic Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models are revolutionizing biological research and biotechnology, yet their vulnerability to data poisoning remains poorly characterized. Here we show that backdoor attacks can be reliably implanted during fine-tuning across diverse model architectures, tasks and model scales by poisoning only a small fraction of training data with short DNA motifs, including triggers derived from transposon terminal inverted repeats (TIRs). Attack success rates are generally high across encoder-based and autoregressive models, while clean-task performance remains almost unchanged. Increasing model scale does not confer measurable resistance. To detect such threats, we develop a two-stage auditing framework that flags potentially poisoned sequences through localized single-nucleotide mutation sensitivity in model predictions, without prior knowledge of trigger sequences. These results identify downstream fine-tuning as an attack surface for genomic foundation models and motivate stronger data provenance, adversarial evaluation and post-training security auditing.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估基因组 foundation model 在微量 DNA 投毒下的后门攻击，并提出无需预先知道触发序列的两阶段审计框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示模型规模未带来可测量的抵抗力，强调训练数据来源、对抗评估和 post-training 安全审计的必要性。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组 foundation model 正在推动生物学研究和生物技术发展，但其对数据投毒的脆弱性仍缺乏充分刻画。我们显示，在不同模型架构、任务和模型规模中，只需在训练数据中加入少量含有短 DNA motif 的投毒样本（包括源自转座子末端反向重复序列（TIR）的触发序列），就可以在微调期间可靠植入后门攻击。基于编码器和自回归的模型通常都具有较高的攻击成功率，而干净任务性能几乎不变。增加模型规模并未带来可测量的抵抗力。为检测这类威胁，我们开发了一个两阶段审计框架，通过模型预测对局部单核苷酸突变的敏感性来标记可能被投毒的序列，而无需预先知道触发序列。这些结果表明，下游微调是基因组 foundation model 的一个攻击面，并提示需要更严格的数据来源追踪、对抗性评估和训练后安全审计。
items.author_line: Ni, S., Wang, Q., Wei, C., Ni, X., Li, S., Zhao, Z., Li, H., Ji, R., Xu, R., Alinejad-Rokny, H., Wang, T., Yang, M.

items.title: Planner-Executor Style Multimodal Agentic System to Answer Patient Questions in Lung Cancer Screening CT
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Accurate patient understanding of lung cancer screening (LCS) results is critical for engagement and follow-up adherence, given the currently low screening uptake. While artificial intelligence (AI) systems show promise in facilitating patient communication, its effective use in clinical settings requires appropriate invocation of imaging tools and self-regulation by deferring certain questions to physicians. To this end, we developed and evaluated a planner-executor style multimodal agentic system to answer simulated patient questions about LCS CT results. Methods: This retrospective study utilized 116 LCS CT reports and images collected from a tertiary academic hospital. The system employed a multi-agent architecture (planner and executor) to mimic clinical reasoning. We developed a large language model (LLM)-based question generation framework to prepare a comprehensive set of 699 simulated patient questions, categorized as answerable and defer-to-doctor to assess self-regulation. Performance was evaluated on tool-calling, self-regulation accuracy (ability to correctly defer out-of-scope questions to a human provider) assessed by LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical quality assessed by a reader performance study with four physicians evaluating a subset of 100 responses. Results: The system demonstrated high overall tool-calling accuracy of 93.1% (646/694; 95% CI: 91.2%, 95.0%) and self-regulation accuracy of 92.6% (462/499; 90.2%, 94.8%). For answerable questions, the percentage of responses receiving perfect 5.0 scores across all readers included 78.9% (180/228) for clinical accuracy (inter-rater agreement: Gwet's AC2=0.92), and 73.2% (167/228) for patient understandability (0.86). For defer-to-doctor questions, the percentage of responses included 77.3% (133/172) for clinical accuracy (0.80) and 70.3% (121/172) for patient understandability (0.78). Conclusions: The planner-executor style multi-modal agentic system reliably answers patient-specific questions about LCS. Its high tool-calling and self-regulation performance demonstrates its potential as a safe and effective digital communication facilitator in LCS programs.
items.summary_zh: 构建 planner-executor 多模态智能体回答肺癌筛查 CT 患者问题，并评估工具调用、自我约束和临床可读性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在116份 CT 报告/影像和699个模拟问题上，系统同时量化了回答能力与应转诊问题的自我限制。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：准确理解肺癌筛查（LCS）结果对于提高参与度和后续随访依从性至关重要，因为当前筛查参与率较低。人工智能（AI）系统有望促进患者沟通，但要在临床环境中有效使用，必须适当调用影像工具，并通过将某些问题交由医生回答来实现自我约束。为此，我们开发并评估了一个 planner-executor 风格的多模态智能体系统，用于回答有关 LCS CT 结果的模拟患者问题。方法：本回顾性研究使用了来自一家三级学术医院的 116 份 LCS CT 报告和影像。系统采用多智能体架构，由 planner 和 executor 组成，以模拟临床推理。我们开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的问题生成框架，构建了 699 个模拟患者问题，并将其分为可回答问题和应转交医生的问题，以评估自我约束能力。评估指标包括工具调用、由 LLM-as-a-judge 评估的自我约束准确率（正确将超出范围的问题转交给人工医务人员的能力），以及临床质量；临床质量通过 4 名医生对部分 100 条回答进行阅评来评估。结果：系统总体工具调用准确率为 93.1%（646/694；95% CI 91.2%–95.0%），自我约束准确率为 92.6%（462/499；90.2%–94.8%）。对于可回答问题，在所有阅评者评分均为满分 5.0 的回答中，临床准确性占 78.9%（180/228；评阅者间一致性 Gwet's AC2=0.92），患者可理解性占 73.2%（167/228；0.86）。对于应转交医生的问题，相应比例分别为临床准确性 77.3%（133/172；0.80）和患者可理解性 70.3%（121/172；0.78）。结论：该 planner-executor 风格多模态智能体系统能够可靠地回答关于 LCS 的患者个体化问题。其较高的工具调用和自我约束表现显示出在 LCS 项目中作为安全、有效的数字沟通促进工具的潜力。
items.author_line: Sakiyama, K., Serapio, A., Ye, M., Nowroozi, A., Bondarenko, M., Wu, Y., Qi, K., Liu, J., Vella, M., Yu, Y., Schnitzler, T., Rustagi, A. S., Sohn, J. H.

items.title: Spatial organization of CAF subtypes establishes a VCAN‑laden neurogenesis‑mimicry barrier driving immune exclusion and immunotherapy resistance in gastric cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Immune checkpoint blockade only generates durable anti-tumor responses in a minor subset of gastric carcinoma patients; transcriptomic evidence indicates stromal fibroblast remodeling is the core driver of immunotherapeutic failure, yet no defined molecular cascade links extracellular matrix stiffening, neural-like cell reprogramming and poor treatment response. We integrated single-cell profiles, Visium spatial sequencing and bulk transcript datasets covering 757 gastric cancer patient specimens to characterize a fibroblast-restricted neurogenesis mimicry (NM) transcriptional program. Matrix-remodeling POSTN⁺/FAP⁺ and structural COL1A1⁺/COL1A2⁺ fibroblast subsets carried elevated NM module scores; CellChat ligand-receptor mapping proved laminin and CD99 signal cascades restructure intercellular communication within high-NM tissue microregions. Unsupervised clustering built upon the 136 fibroblast-specific NM signature separated all enrolled patients into three subgroups with divergent long-term survival trajectories. Ten independent survival prediction algorithms were benchmarked, and random survival forest (RSF) delivered optimal predictive power with an average C-index of 0.84, with stable performance recorded across eight fully independent validation cohorts. Reverse single-cell projection localized all bulk-derived prognostic risk signals to stromal fibroblast and endothelial cell populations. SHAP interpretable modeling paired with scTenifoldKnk single-gene virtual knockout identified a ten-gene functional module centered on VCAN; these genes exclusively expressed in high-NM fibroblasts and correlated with epithelial-mesenchymal transition, invasive phenotypes and angiogenic activity. After adjusting age, gender and pathological stage covariates, continuous RSF risk scores retained independent prognostic capacity. High-risk lesions recorded elevated TIDE values and M2 macrophage enrichment, consistent with an immune-excluded cold tumor phenotype. Visium spatial mapping localized NM fibroblast hotspots adjacent to disordered microvessels and dense fibrotic stromal borders. Cell-free biophysical binding assays (SPR/BLI) paired with in vivo orthotopic syngeneic models validated the dual oncogenic effects of NM-high fibroblasts: VCAN-rich extracellular matrix forms physical barriers to trap cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells, while paracrine VCAN directly binds Integrin β1 to activate AKT/ERK signaling, inducing neuron-like transdifferentiation and accelerating gastric carcinoma progression. Multi-dimensional profiling infers fibroblast-dependent neurogenesis mimicry acts as a druggable stromal driver for gastric cancer progression and immunotherapy resistance, with VCAN-laden matrix walls representing a precise therapeutic target to reverse immune exclusion.
items.summary_zh: 整合757份胃癌样本的单细胞、空间和 bulk 数据，解析 VCAN 富集 CAF 介导的免疫排斥与免疫治疗耐药。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随机生存森林在8个独立验证队列中保持稳定，并由 SPR/BLI 与同基因移植模型提供了体外和体内支持。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：免疫检查点阻断仅能在少数胃癌患者中产生持久的抗肿瘤反应；转录组证据表明，基质成纤维细胞重塑是免疫治疗失败的核心驱动因素，但尚无明确的分子级联将细胞外基质硬化、神经样细胞重编程和治疗反应不佳联系起来。我们整合单细胞图谱、Visium 空间测序和 bulk 转录组数据，覆盖 757 份胃癌患者样本，以刻画成纤维细胞限制性的神经发生模拟（NM）转录程序。基质重塑型 POSTN⁺/FAP⁺ 和结构型 COL1A1⁺/COL1A2⁺ 成纤维细胞亚群具有较高的 NM 模块评分；CellChat 配体—受体映射证明，laminin 和 CD99 信号级联会重塑高 NM 组织微区中的细胞间通信。基于 136 基因成纤维细胞特异性 NM 特征的无监督聚类，将所有纳入患者分为三个长期生存轨迹不同的亚组。我们比较了 10 种独立生存预测算法，随机生存森林（RSF）取得最佳预测能力，平均 C-index 为 0.84，并在 8 个完全独立的验证队列中保持稳定性能。反向单细胞投影将所有源自 bulk 的预后风险信号定位到基质成纤维细胞和内皮细胞群。SHAP 可解释建模结合 scTenifoldKnk 单基因虚拟敲除，识别出以 VCAN 为中心的十基因功能模块；这些基因仅在高 NM 成纤维细胞中表达，并与上皮—间质转化、侵袭表型和血管生成活性相关。在校正年龄、性别和病理分期协变量后，连续 RSF 风险评分仍保留独立的预后能力。高风险病灶具有较高的 TIDE 值和 M2 巨噬细胞富集，与免疫排斥型冷肿瘤表型一致。Visium 空间定位显示，NM 成纤维细胞热点邻近紊乱的微血管和致密的纤维化基质边界。细胞游离生物物理结合实验（SPR/BLI）结合体内原位同基因移植模型，验证了 NM 高表达成纤维细胞的双重致癌效应：富含 VCAN 的细胞外基质形成物理屏障，捕获细胞毒性 CD8⁺ T 细胞；旁分泌 VCAN 直接结合 Integrin β1，激活 AKT/ERK 信号，诱导神经样转分化并加速胃癌进展。多维度分析推断，成纤维细胞依赖的神经发生模拟可能是胃癌进展和免疫治疗耐药的可药物作用基质驱动因素，而富含 VCAN 的基质壁可能是逆转免疫排斥的精准治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Yang L, Fan J, Liu Z, Dai J, Wang L, Zhu X, Yuan H, Dong Z, Wei T, Song H, Huang R, Li L, Yu Z, Han P, Fang T, Song H

items.title: Connectomics by Sequencing Reveals Self-Organizing Principles of Neuronal Networks in Cerebral Organoids
items.abstract_or_text: Functional neural networks emerge as developing neurons form synaptic connections. Revealing how these connections are organized and perturbed in disease requires linking single-neuron connectivity to molecular state across thousands of networks, which is challenging with current methods. We developed COSCO (Connectomics by Sequencing in Cerebral Organoids), combining barcoded monosynaptic rabies tracing with single-cell RNA sequencing to reconstruct over 10,000 networks across organoids. We demonstrate that organoid circuitry self-organizes into stereotyped network motifs governed by cell-intrinsic wiring rules aligning with features of mouse cortical connectivity. Projecting network topology onto transcriptomic space reveals that wiring correlates with cell-adhesion and synaptic gene expression programs. In a Tuberous Sclerosis Complex model, pathological hyperexcitability coincides with topological rewiring: mutant networks become more heterogeneous, driven by the transcriptional distribution of upper layer excitatory cell states. This work establishes cerebral organoids as a model to study self-organization of human connectivity, and its disruption in neurodevelopmental disease.
items.summary_zh: COSCO 将条形码单突触狂犬病毒示踪与单细胞 RNA 测序结合，在脑类器官中重建超过10000个神经网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把单神经元连接、转录状态和结节性硬化症模型中的病理性重连放到同一分析框架。
items.abstract_zh: 功能性神经网络在发育中的神经元形成突触连接时出现。要揭示这些连接如何组织以及在疾病中如何受到扰动，需要将单个神经元的连接性与数千个网络中的分子状态联系起来，而现有方法难以完成这一点。我们开发了 COSCO（Connectomics by Sequencing in Cerebral Organoids），将带条形码的单突触狂犬病毒示踪与单细胞 RNA 测序结合起来，在类器官中重建超过 10,000 个网络。我们证明，类器官回路会自组织形成刻板的网络模体，其组织受到细胞内在布线规则的支配，并与小鼠皮层连接的特征相一致。将网络拓扑投射到转录组空间后发现，布线与细胞黏附和突触基因表达程序相关。在结节性硬化症复合征模型中，病理性高兴奋性与拓扑重连相伴：突变网络的异质性增加，这一变化由上层兴奋性细胞状态的转录分布驱动。本研究确立了脑类器官作为研究人类连接自组织及其在神经发育疾病中受扰动的模型。
